assessment_summary: I validated the non-docker installation path (Node v24 + pnpm + self-managed PostgreSQL 15/PostGIS) described in the guide. Steps: (1) Inspected /workspace and confirmed repo checkout, node_modules, compiled dist/, .env.dev config matching the sample. (2) Verified prerequisites: Node v24.22.0, pnpm 11.1.2 (exact packageManager match), PG15 cluster 15/main online on port 5432 with PostGIS 3.6.4 + postgis_raster, and restored sample data (15 tables in `ga`, 1 in `ga_efa`). (3) Confirmed the app is running as `pnpm run start` (nest compiling to dist/main and executing). (4) Exercised every access point documented in the guide: /api (Swagger UI 200), /api-json (full OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec, 200), /health (200 ok), /metrics (Prometheus output), /v2/topics (DB-backed topic list). (5) Proved end-to-end functionality with real spatial queries against the sample data: /v2/intersect correctly identified Dresden as the kreis/gemeinde for the example point; /v2/valuesAtPoint returned raster elevation values via postgis_raster; /v2/within, /v2/nearestNeighbour, and both transform endpoints returned 200 with numerically correct EPSG:25833 projection. No errors observed. The only deviations from the guide are benign: the auto-pulled PG18 cluster remains down (unused), and the documented non-fatal pg_restore warning (transaction_timeout, a PG17+ parameter) did not affect data completeness, as confirmed by successful spatial queries. The docker-compose alternative was not needed per the summary and was not exercised; per validation rules, missing artifacts of an unused alternate method do not constitute failure. Conclusion: the installation is complete and the software operates exactly as documented — success.
